chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Shu'ayb al-Haddad, from Mu'alla ibn Khunays, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who divorced his wife, then did not revert to her until she had three menstrual periods, then he married her, then divorced her, and left her until she had three menstrual periods without him reverting to her (meaning touching her). He (peace be upon him) said: 'He can marry her forever, as long as he does not revert to her and touch her.'
ai.seo_question: Can a man remarry his ex-wife multiple times if he divorces her before consummating the marriage each time?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the specific mechanics of 'Talaq al-Mughallazah' (the major divorce) by distinguishing between the act of divorce and the consummation of the marriage. The Imam establishes that the irrevocable barrier to remarriage is lifted only upon actual physical intimacy (mass) during the interim marriage, rather than merely the passage of time or the legal contract itself. This highlights the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on physical consummation as the definitive marker for resetting the marital status in complex divorce scenarios.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Shuayb Al Hadda, from Moala Bin Khunays,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who divorced his wife, then did not revert back to her until she menstruated with three menstruation. Then he married her, then divorced her. So he left her until she menstruated with three menstruations from without him reverting back to her, meaning touching her’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For him is that he can marry her forever for as long as he does not revert back to her and touches’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘ Abd af-Malik ibn al-Mughirah from Shu’ayb al-Haddad from Mu ‘alia’ ibn al-Khunays who has said the following:

“There is a man who divorces his wife and does not go back to her until three Hayd (menses) are complete, then marries her then divorces her and leaves until three Hayd (menses) are complete and does not go back to her to touch her. Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘He can marry forever as long as he does not go back to her to touch”’
